verdict.rationale: Appwrite docs confirm MFA support for app users (appwrite-docs-4) and OAuth sign-in with 30+ providers (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-26), but there is no evidence of enterprise SSO via SAML or OIDC protocols, nor any mention of admin-enforced/mandatory MFA policy for platform-level control. missing for 10: SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO support, admin-level enforcement/policy controls for MFA, independent confirmation of these enterprise auth features.
